prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: Best if you already use SEO suites
answer_verbatim:
For most small businesses, **Otterly.AI** is the best *starting point* if you want a simple, affordable service to check whether AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your business, because it is repeatedly positioned as a small-business-friendly monitoring tool and starts around **$25–$29/month**.[3][5][9]

If you want the **best overall value** rather than the cheapest entry, **Ayzeo** is also a strong contender: one source calls it the “best overall value” for small businesses, with plans starting from **$39/month** and a stronger reporting/integration setup on higher plans.[3]

A practical way to choose:

- **Cheapest useful option:** **Otterly.AI** — good for basic brand monitoring across ChatGPT and similar engines.[3][5]
- **Best value / more features:** **Ayzeo** — better if you want more reporting and business-oriented workflow support.[3]
- **Best free baseline:** **AIScope** (AI Marketing Labs) or similar free diagnostics, if you want to see what AI says before paying.[5]
- **Best if you already use SEO suites:** **Ahrefs Brand Radar** or **Semrush AI Visibility**; these fit better if you want AI visibility inside a broader SEO workflow.[2][15]

If your main question is simply, “**Does ChatGPT recommend my business?**” then start with **Otterly.AI** or a free baseline report first, then upgrade only if you need deeper competitor tracking or citation analysis.[3][5][11]
